title: 第1章 强者为尊第2章 九龙神诀
content_zh:
镇南王宫，紫极偏殿。
“不！
不！”
一张鎏金床撵上，江若尘猛然嘶吼坐起，淋漓的满头大汗，像是做了极度恐怖的噩梦。
“塔，深渊！
我……还活着？”
坐起的江若尘握紧双拳，感受到痛意中夹杂着一丝力量，这才肯定，自己确实还活着！
“我不是在地底探险，而后被地底神秘古塔拖入深渊了吗？这是哪里……”
确定自己还活着的江若尘，目光扫视周围的环境，发现自己正在一间古色古香的房间中。
房间装潢华丽，像是影视剧中的皇宫。
啊！
江若尘正疑惑时，脑袋突然传来一阵剧痛，一股陌生且庞大的记忆涌入了他的脑海。
刹那，江若尘就犹如被雷击了一般，呆坐在床上。
“我……穿越了？”
好一会，他才从庞大的记忆中缓冲过来。
他穿越了！
而且穿越到了强者为尊，弱肉强食的玄幻世界。
在这里，弱者没有任何的地位可言，卑贱如狗。
而强大者不仅拥有搬山填海的惊天伟力，更能掌控亿万人的生死。
只要实力足够强大，什么皇朝大教，天子圣女，都会在你脚下臣服……

“我好好的一个探险家，为什么会穿越到如此倒霉的冤种身上？就算穿越，就不能给我待遇好点吗？”
吸收完记忆的江若尘，欲哭无泪。
只因他吸收完了记忆，也彻底明白了“原身”
的冤种处境。
原身与他同名同姓，也叫江若尘，乃是这混元大陆千百万王朝之一的镇南王朝王子之一。
这身份地位按道理来说非常尊贵，若是放到影视剧里去，几乎不作死就终生无忧，地位显赫。
可这偏偏是个强者为尊的世界，哪怕贵为王子，没有足够的实力支撑，也是只待宰的刍狗！
就比如前身的死，就是很好的例子。
前身江若尘，因皇子身份，从小就与镇南王朝的大将军嫡女秦琪，指腹为婚。
王家与心腹大臣联姻，这本是镇南王朝天大的好事。
可谁也没有想到，随着时间的推移，原本看起来天造地设的联姻，渐渐变得不是那么回事了起来。
秦琪，六岁起就能接触武道，八岁时更是直接觉醒了武魂印记，正式成为了强大的修炼者。
反观江若尘，虽是王室血脉，可从小身子骨羸弱，不说觉醒武魂印记，就是接触武道都是奢侈！
在如此强烈的对比下，当初定下的婚约，自然就成了一桩笑话，也成了世人，茶余饭后的谈资。
每当提起江若尘，总是会跟废物，虎父犬子……等等一系列难听的话挂钩。
事情变成这样，按道理来说，婚约肯定要悄然作罢，免得再给林家，给王室蒙羞。
可偏偏前身还是个情种，倔种。
content_en:
Zhennan Palace, Ziji Side Hall.
"No!
No! "
A gilt bed was thrown onto the bed, and Jiang Ruochen suddenly roared and sat up, sweating profusely, as if he had had an extremely terrifying nightmare.
“Tower, abyss!
Am I...still alive? "
Jiang Ruochen sat up and clenched his fists. He felt a hint of strength mixed with the pain, and then he was sure that he was indeed still alive!
"Didn't I explore underground and then be dragged into the abyss by a mysterious underground tower? Where is this..."
Jiang Ruochen, who was sure he was still alive, scanned the surrounding environment and found that he was in an antique room.
The room is gorgeously decorated, like a palace in a movie or TV show.
ah!
Just when Jiang Ruochen was wondering, there was a sudden sharp pain in his head, and a strange and huge memory poured into his mind.
In an instant, Jiang Ruochen sat blankly on the bed as if he had been struck by lightning.
"I... traveled through time?"
It took him a while to recover from the huge memory.
He has traveled through time!
Moreover, he traveled to a fantasy world where the strong are respected and the weak are eaten by the strong.
Here, the weak have no status at all and are as humble as dogs.
The powerful not only have the astonishing power to move mountains and reclaim seas, but they can also control the lives and deaths of hundreds of millions of people.
As long as you are strong enough, all dynasties, emperors and saints will surrender at your feet...
"I am a good explorer, why would I travel through time and end up with such an unlucky enemy? Even if I travel through time, can't you treat me better?"
After absorbing the memory, Jiang Ruochen wanted to cry but had no tears.
Just because he has absorbed the memory and completely understood the "original body"
of injustice.
His original name was Jiang Ruochen, and he was one of the princes of the Zhennan Dynasty, one of the millions of dynasties in the Hunyuan Continent.
Logically speaking, this status is very noble. If it were shown in movies and TV dramas, one would have a life-long worry-free life and a prominent status without risking death.
But this is a world where the strong are respected. Even if you are a prince, if you don't have enough strength to support him, he is just a dumb dog waiting to be slaughtered!
For example, the death of the predecessor is a good example.
His predecessor, Jiang Ruochen, was married to Qin Qi, the legitimate daughter of the general of the Zhennan Dynasty, on the fingertips of his body since he was a child because of his status as a prince.
The marriage between the Wang family and their close ministers was a great blessing for the Zhennan Dynasty.
But no one expected that as time went by, the marriage that seemed to be a match made in heaven gradually became something else.
Qin Qi has been exposed to martial arts since she was six years old. When she was eight years old, she directly awakened the martial soul mark and officially became a powerful practitioner.
On the other hand, although Jiang Ruochen is of royal blood, his body has been weak since he was a child. Not to mention awakening the martial soul mark, even being exposed to martial arts is a luxury!
In such a strong contrast, the original engagement naturally became a joke and became the talk of the world after dinner.
Whenever Jiang Ruochen is mentioned, he will always be associated with a series of unpleasant words such as trash, tiger father and dog son...etc.
With things turning like this, logically speaking, the engagement must be quietly broken off, so as not to bring shame to the Lin family and the royal family.
But my predecessor was still a passionate and stubborn person.
